visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot introduces a finished breakfast plate featuring a golden rolled omelet, sautéed mushrooms, and grilled tomatoes garnished with fresh herbs. (2) A person's hands hold a 20cm cast-iron pan with a wooden handle in a modern kitchen setting with spice jars visible in the background. (3) The cook's finger presses buttons on a black induction stove to adjust the heat settings. (4) In a blue and white ceramic bowl, the cook whisks two eggs rapidly using wooden chopsticks until the mixture is uniform. (5) A blue digital timer is shown indicating time has passed, followed by the cook turning off the stove heat. (6) Cooking oil is poured into the pan and swirled to coat the surface completely while heating. (7) The whisked egg liquid is poured into the center of the pan, beginning to set and bubble at the edges immediately. (8) Using a black spatula, the cook gently moves the egg and begins rolling it into a log shape to form an omelet. (9) The completed omelet is transferred to a white plate, and sliced shiitake mushrooms are added to the same pan. (10) Salt and pepper are ground over the mushrooms using a clear mill as they sauté in the residual oil. (11) The mushrooms are tossed and then plated alongside the omelet. (12) Fresh green-black tomatoes are sliced and placed into the pan with a little more olive oil. (13) A glass lid is placed over the pan to steam the tomatoes, then removed later to show them grilled and charred. (14) The tomatoes are served on the plate, and balsamic vinegar is drizzled over the entire dish as a final touch.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 日常早餐隨手拍 一鍋做三菜 營養早餐自己來. (2) [Subtitle]: 一個人 吃飽飽. (3) [Subtitle]: 像這樣20公分的 鍋子就可以了. (4) [Subtitle]: 不要太大、太重的鍋. (5) [Subtitle]: 鑄鐵鍋先開中火 熱鍋兩分鐘. (6) [Subtitle]: 感應爐開 5. (7) [Subtitle]: 一旁打兩顆蛋. (8) [Variety]: 時間到囉！😘. (9) [Subtitle]: 先關火30秒. (10) [Subtitle]: 先讓鍋子稍微降溫. (11) [Subtitle]: 倒入5~7克的油... (12) [Subtitle]: 開中小火加熱. (13) [Subtitle]: 搖晃一下鍋子 確認油紋狀態... (14) [Subtitle]: 若用橄欖油火不能太大！ (15) [Subtitle]: 倒入蛋液... (16) [Subtitle]: 看到邊緣蛋液 膨脹起來. (17) [Subtitle]: 撥動一下... (18) [Subtitle]: 這樣就可以翻動了. (19) [Variety]: 捲起來...😘. (20) [Subtitle]: 壓一壓 煎出蛋香... (21) [Variety]: 今天蛋好像煎的不夠美 😐. (22) [Variety]: 有成功不沾黏就好了 😆. (23) [Subtitle]: 跟著我的操作方式 用鑄鐵鍋蛋都不會沾鍋喔！ (24) [Slogan]: 起鍋~. (25) [Subtitle]: 接下來再來做其他菜. (26) [Subtitle]: 原來的鍋子 放入香菇... (27) [Slogan]: 壓一壓. (28) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、胡椒調味. (29) [Subtitle]: 慢慢煎到香菇出水 煎出表面焦香.. (30) [Subtitle]: 像這樣就差不多了 一點香料調味... (31) [Variety]: 兩樣菜完成！😆😋. (32) [Subtitle]: 鍋子不用洗 放入橄欖油.. (33) [Subtitle]: 番茄放進來 開中小火煎.... (34) [Subtitle]: 用牛番茄即可 (我剛好只有黑柿番茄). (35) [Subtitle]: 趕緊蓋上鍋蓋 (慢慢的悶煎). (36) [Variety]: 好囉，開蓋😆. (37) [Subtitle]: 番茄煎到表面這樣 有點焦香. (38) [Variety]: 很好吃！😋😋. (39) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽調味. (40) [Subtitle]: 再來一點 巴薩米克醋更好吃！ (41) [Subtitle]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube：. (42) [Slogan]: 最後一點香料 ... 完成 ❤️😊.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a gentle acoustic guitar melody accompanied by soft female vocals singing in English. A brief mechanical click is heard as the induction cooker is activated. (2) The musical theme continues with a peaceful atmosphere. Sharp tapping sounds occur as eggs are beaten, followed by the rapid, rhythmic wooden clacking of chopsticks whisking in a bowl. (3) A clear digital beeping sound effect alerts the cook of the timer. A low sizzling sound begins when oil is poured, increasing into a crisp crackle when the egg liquid hits the hot metal. (4) Sizzling persists throughout the cooking process. Occasional metallic scraping sounds from the spatula are heard during the omelet rolling. (5) A hollow clattering sound marks the mushrooms entering the pan, followed by the low-frequency grinding noise of a manual pepper mill. (6) High-frequency sizzling and steam release sounds occur while the tomatoes cook under the lid, ending with the clatter of the lid being removed. (7) The music fades out smoothly during the final seasoning and plating, concluded by a soft closing jingle.
